sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen3.8 Flash Next Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is the first open model built on the Qwen4 architecture that you can run locally: a 125B Mixture-of-Experts model that activates 6B parameters per token and runs from a 64 GB MacBook up, with its 51B n-gram table paged from SSD.
